integrity: Proof and reproducible seven-field exhaustive enumeration supplied; characteristic and small-field cases included; independent validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: Only perfect three-dimensional evolution algebras with all nine natural-basis structure constants nonzero; ordinary finite-field-linear automorphisms; no group schemes, non-full-support cases, or semilinear equivalences. Literature comparisons do not prove global priority.
title: Automorphism-order strata of full-support three-dimensional evolution algebras over finite fields
